scope_boundary: Root must separately author/admit any exact inert execution or doubles. No native/real process/fixture outcome supplied by recipes.

first_error_coordinates.caller_pump_or_setup: Outer receipt errors[0] at the specified exact stage, with injected actual type/message; subsequent cleanup errors append.
first_error_coordinates.direct_ps_helper: Raw observer journal errors[0] string begins with the specified ps stage. Its raised Refusal keeps that first string before any later observer-tail errors.
first_error_coordinates.outer_with_failed_ps: Outer errors[0].stage is supervision and its message retains the first ps issue; direct helper journal oracle and outer wrapping are separate.
first_error_coordinates.fallback: Keep first observer/journal supervision error. direct_handle_kill/direct_handle_reap append as secondary only; actual returncode/reaped fields require genuine poll observation.
first_error_coordinates.positive_pump: No pump error. A separate inherited nonempty-stderr rejection is required where the positive pump case writes stderr; it is not overall acceptance.
